mentions.name: Easy Invoice PDF
mentions.description: A free and open-source web-based invoice generator that works without sign-up or ads. It offers live PDF preview with instant download, saved seller and buyer profiles, flexible tax support (VAT, GST, sales tax, etc.), fully customizable invoice templates, and support for 120+ currencies and 10 languages. Planned work includes a backend for recurring invoices, a public API, and an MCP server; the project has reached 1k stars on GitHub.

mentions.name: Easy Invoice PDF
mentions.description: This free and open-source invoice generator works entirely in-browser with no sign-up required. It offers live PDF preview and instant PDF download, flexible tax support (VAT, GST, Sales Tax, and custom tax formats with automatic calculations), shareable invoice links, 10+ languages and 120+ currencies, multiple templates including a Stripe-style option, payment QR codes for invoice-related info (payment links, UPI, contact details, custom data), and multi-page PDFs with automatic pagination and page breaks. E-invoice support is in progress.
